_read_me: RaveSafe Heads Up reviewed entries. Nothing shows on the website unless status is approved AND approved_by and approved_at are filled in. Drafts never show. See README for how to add one.

_categories.alert: Alert: significant risk needing timely awareness or action
_categories.heads-up: Heads Up: worth knowing, not urgent
_categories.one-to-watch: One to Watch: credible early finding, not yet a pattern

_template.title: Short plain headline
_template.summary: One or two sentences on what was found.
_template.sold_as: What it was sold or submitted as
_template.evidence_type: Laboratory-confirmed | Official public health warning | Surveillance signal
_template.issuing_org: Who issued the warning, if different
_template.source_url: Direct link to the original result or warning
_template.location_label: Local | Regional UK | UK-wide | European | International | Location unknown
_template.location_detail: Where tested, submitted or bought, as far as known
_template.original_warning_level: The source's own warning level, if it has one
_template.why_classified: Why we've classified this: what's confirmed, why it matters, why this category is proportionate.
_template.approved_by: Name of the person who approved it
